choose.when:
SELECT 'POST' AS content_type, p.post_id AS content_id, p.user_id AS author_user_id, au.nickname AS author_nickname, p.title, LEFT(p.content, 100) AS content_summary, p.status, p.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='POST' AND r.target_id=p.post_id) AS report_count
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'COMMENT' AS content_type, c.comment_id AS content_id, c.user_id AS author_user_id, au.nickname AS author_nickname, NULL AS title, LEFT(c.content, 100) AS content_summary, c.status, c.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='COMMENT' AND r.target_id=c.comment_id) AS report_count
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'REVIEW' AS content_type, br.review_id AS content_id, br.user_id AS author_user_id, au.nickname AS author_nickname, NULL AS title, LEFT(br.content, 100) AS content_summary, br.status, br.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='REVIEW' AND r.target_id=br.review_id) AS report_count
ORDER BY br.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS content_type, NULL AS content_id, NULL AS author_user_id, NULL AS author_nickname, NULL AS title, NULL AS content_summary, NULL AS status, NULL AS created_at, 0 AS report_count FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0

choose.when: SELECT 'POST' AS content_type, p.post_id AS content_id, p.user_id AS author_user_id, au.nickname AS author_nickname, p.title, p.content, p.status, NULL AS parent_post_id, p.book_id, p.category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='POST' AND r.target_id=p.post_id) AS report_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM posts p JOIN users au ON au.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{contentId}

SELECT 'COMMENT' AS content_type, c.comment_id AS content_id, c.user_id AS author_user_id, au.nickname AS author_nickname, NULL AS title, c.content, c.status, c.post_id AS parent_post_id, NULL AS book_id, NULL AS category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='COMMENT' AND r.target_id=c.comment_id) AS report_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM post_comments c JOIN users au ON au.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{contentId}

SELECT 'REVIEW' AS content_type, br.review_id AS content_id, br.user_id AS author_user_id, au.nickname AS author_nickname, NULL AS title, br.content, br.status, NULL AS parent_post_id, br.book_id, NULL AS category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports r WHERE r.target_type='REVIEW' AND r.target_id=br.review_id) AS report_count, br.created_at, br.updated_at FROM book_reviews br JOIN users au ON au.user_id = br.user_id WHERE br.review_id = #{contentId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS content_type, NULL AS content_id, NULL AS author_user_id, NULL AS author_nickname, NULL AS title, NULL AS content, NULL AS status, NULL AS parent_post_id, NULL AS book_id, NULL AS category, 0 AS report_count, NULL AS created_at, NULL AS updated_at FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0

SELECT status FROM post_comments WHERE comment_id = #{contentId}

UPDATE post_comments SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE comment_id = #{contentId}
UPDATE book_reviews SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE review_id = #{contentId}
